☛ Grammar Rule: The preposition without requires a noun to convey negation (no division). Segmentation fits perfectly as it denotes a negative context.
☛ Exam Tip: Always analyze the broader context—here, "holistically" and "pre-nursery to Class 12" hint at unity, making segmentation the antonymic correct choice.

☛ Grammar Rule: Certainly एक adverb है जो क्रिया (reduces) को modify करता है और confidence के साथ कारण-प्रभाव दिखाता है।

solution:

Explanation:
☛ The parallel structure rule applies here. The first blank uses "more" trees as it aligns with increasing the "amount of oxygen".
☛ The second blank also requires "more" oxygen to maintain logical coherence. "Growing more trees means more oxygen" establishes a direct cause-effect relationship.
☛ Comparative degree is apt here as the passage discusses improvement (increase in oxygen).
☛ Other options like "less" or "no" contradict the context, which focuses on addressing oxygen depletion.

Grammar Rule:
☛ When two related actions/things show proportional growth, use the same comparative form (here "more") for both.
